items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: In '44 I did a lot of things for Artie Shaw.

ctx.x: (Side B of Tape 1 begins at this point.)
--that last winter, '35 and '36. That's when Benny had started to hit it. Who else? I guess the Dorsey Brothers. Bob Crosby too. Artie Shaw.

It's interesting, I was at the Institute of Jazz Studies last Friday playing somethings that you had written that I hadn't heard, and I heard some of those things from the Red Norvo period like "Love Song to a Chambermaid".
